summary: Community mapping application with interactive globe showing user locations

existing_features.title: Make the address field required in the SetCoordinatesDialog component on the community map page so users cannot submit without providing their address
Add zoom in and zoom out controls to the GlobeMap component so users can control the camera distance to the globe
Display user locations with visible pin markers on the globe in the GlobeMap component showing where users live based on their addresses

new_feature_requests.summary: Make address a required field in the community map page
Add zoom in/out functionality to the globe
Display user locations with pins on the globe

projectName: Make address required and add zoom controls with location pins to community map
